description.value:
Range 30 feet

You no longer need a hand on them. A Passing you perform can target a creature within 30 feet instead of only an adjacent one. You must be able to see the target and have a clear line of effect to it; a Passing performed at range is otherwise identical, including its Passage cost, its requirements and how long it takes.

cinderfall.incomplete: Ashcantor's entire signature resource system (Passage, a Passing, Walking Through, Embers, Ash-Light) has zero rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus -- the class card itself (classes.ashcantor.json) ships system.rules: [], and no abilities/ or class-features/ card exists to hold a Passage/Ember mechanic either. Checked pf2e's own generic SpecialResource rule element (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/special-resource.ts:24-247) as a possible fit: every real user (Alchemist's Versatile Vials, Gunslinger's Munitions Machinist, Fumbus's iconic feats) is a daily-refilling consumable counter, never a one-way permanent-increase track like Passage -- no real class resource matches Passage's shape, so there is no base mechanic here to extend or modify. Specifically, this extends the range of "a Passing," which has no item or action card to attach a range modifier to.
